marker_free_review.reason: Stable-reference facade is already explicitly mapped; it is not counted as an original/public dependency implementation.

The two complete native point-selection functions were missing. Imported and corrected four decimal transcription errors against every literal qword in saved native decompilation; 41 points across six curve variants compare bitwise.

HistoryChainIndex is a primitive wrapper; HistoryEditChain forwards ordinary Vec operations and depends on an unclosed MultiEdit schema. No private algorithm here to reconstruct instead of std. Verified transaction/history policies and raw schema are already in formal packages.

Old source invents enabled:bool from a 7-byte empty void() decompile. The later recovered consumer has actual {disc:u32,payload:u32}; disabled/state transitions are already represented there, not by this incompatible bool schema.
initiate_game_shutdown only binds then discards both input/output arguments. It neither reads events nor queues resource insertion. Marker-free does not make this an implementation.

Corner representation is explicitly inferred (id+1) and to-id(None)->0 is not independently established. Identity/presence/anchor fields already decoded from observed rows in accepted decorator_info; do not introduce the incompatible inferred repr(u8)+payload layout as finished ABI.
Only HashMap::clear is wrapped; no private gate construction policy is present. The actual recovered gate placement/distribution and runtime cleanup already exist.
Game-facing call descriptions already mapped; invented GPU import handles are confined to tests and actual import/export requires BufferGraphBackend.

Only a zero constructor and ordinary wrapping_add wrapper are present; source cites inline metadata but supplies no recovered actual system call/width/starting/overflow contract. This is not a completed system producer. The actual frame-constant read/reset rule is imported separately.

Driver/follow/advance/update bodies exist, but the stopped camera evidence has no closed current function acceptance. Its source assertion that machine-code verification occurred is not supported by the current camera audit; driver/selection producer remains a candidate.

Trait/query adapters and guessed bounds/smoothing policies are not accepted body recovery. Closed projection/matrix utilities already exist in formal utils; only the independently closed 45-degree leaf was imported.

Implemented dolly driver/get/set/translation wrappers lack a closed original-control-flow acceptance, and source mixes game glam0.29 with dolly glam0.27 via mint. This is a specific unaccepted camera candidate, not exclusion because the entire camera system is incomplete.
The old orbit update still contains 11.0125/33.45/46/90 constants; original audit confirms 12.025/33.475/44.85/89.7 at 0x140949fe0. Cannot count this wrong body as completed source.
Spherecast/slide/ground code exists but true producer/filter/type contracts and complete native control-flow acceptance are not closed; stopped source assertions do not provide that validation.
show_lazy_grid_debug is an empty function; LazyGridDebug is only a bool data tag.

Two wrappers merely call History methods; no recovered recording policy here. Original finish_input_recording was audited as an EventWriter operation, not the old snapshot-append implementation. Do not pull the incompatible History skeleton for forwarding wrappers.
Hardcodes undo=false and WallId(0), ignores edit/dt, and clears all pairs for the unused alternate branch; this is not recovered replay. The closed Delete{id} wire schema is already imported.
The animation body is empty; no thickness progression exists.
ivy_leaf_animation is empty; bool component alone is a data tag, not animation logic.
is_point_still_valid always false; three prune/remove command functions are empty.
Leaf/flower Vec carriers exist, but packing/upload function is empty. Completed draw-side bind callbacks are already retained.
Segment Vec carrier only; GPU packing/upload function is empty. Completed draw-side binding/count rules already imported.
Inside-wall always false, cursor root always None, system empty; try_random_ivy_root merely delegates to guessed IvyStorage::spawn_ivy without original root-selection logic.
Three system/event/resource registration functions are empty; build only constructs unclosed Ivy resource defaults. No completed algorithm omitted.
Ignores mode/roof/signifier/event outputs and picks the first premade wall instead of the intersected wall. Closed numeric height/edit rules are already included.
Uses first four segments and X/Y, while audited native body uses last four (n-1-i) and X/Z. Includes invented zero-length policy. Not a completed body.

Current Rust despawns both removed Entity-map values. Saved native decompile performs two removals but exposes a despawn branch only for the second result; the original contract/audit statements conflict. Do not select an ownership algorithm without original assembly/caller reconciliation. Other completed wall deletion/lifecycle CPU rules are retained.

Queues all walls with fabricated low=.3/high=.7; archival/icon bodies are empty and reconnect predicate always false. The completed parsed-input bulldoze history/animation lives in recovered_building.

Old source samples only world origin, never accumulates curve sum/max, discards the sample, and writes a temporary PreviewCircle instead of the real cache. Formal wall_freeform_cache has recovered shape sampling/height logic.
Ignores action/mode/UI/output events and fixes radius=1.0; signifier is constructed then discarded. new is a plain zero-field constructor, not recovered UI policy.
Reads one plane hit and searches for a circle, then only borrows inner_walls; no curve/enclosure/history update occurs.
Only init_resource forwarding to an old fake App; no business algorithm. Never copy that public-engine replacement.

Old source compares absolute dims length/angle!=0 and calls empty history.mark_changed; its rotation helper normalizes/clamps instead of native ordered dot/acos policy. Formal CPU source contains original finish decision/event ordering.
Fixes dims=(1,1), ignores creation events, discards orientation helper and returns abs(delta). This is not a recovered dimension-from-rotated-cursor function.
Unconditionally sets mode=1 and does no length/projection work; older documentation incorrectly selects first segment instead of native longest segment and total-length gate.
Ignores AppMode/UI/modifier/intersection inputs, signifier is empty, suppression always resets false on cursor event. finish only clears fields and is not a separate business algorithm.
Ignores AppMode/drag/release state and depends on fake glade/UI predicates; creates and discards a zero debug line. Does not implement the described real recording/finish branches.
Writes only WallHighlight fields but discards EditingHighlight.raw, omitting observed color branch. The renderer input view is imported; this truncated producer is not a complete function.
Calculates a guessed step_by and constructs/discards DebugSphere; never writes the signifier stream or reproduces the actual threshold curve.
Discards mouse/cell centers and constructs/discards zero-sized geometry; does not publish debug output.
x0y is already in formal utils. The old zero-argument xvy returns (x,y,0), conflicts with the original xvy(vertical_y) adapter, and should not replace the fuller recovered utility.
